Nevertheless, discovery metadata is used as support for several solution recommendations despite its explicit warning that applicability is not evidence; the answer does not distinguish this limited support from full method-card evidence. experiment_quality.rationale: Provides a genuine baseline comparison, independently adjudicated labels, representative row sampling, candidate/pair/entity metrics, serial and depot slices, compute and review costs, and positive/negative/inconclusive decisions. The guardrails are incomplete: entity disjointness is optional while the specified row split permits identity leakage; all 60 label hours are then assigned to a test set without an explicit source of training and threshold-tuning labels. Actual relation-signal ablations with fixed candidates/resolver, predeclared false-merge and CPU acceptance thresholds, and a concrete uncertainty procedure are not specified. Thus the experiment is informative but not the fully controlled falsifiable design anchored at 3.
